sources.license_and_retention: Item metadata has no explicit open reuse license. Metadata says CDO data are informational/as-is and accuracy, timeliness, completeness are not warranted. No feature-response bytes are committed; reproducible query and its prior response digest are recorded. Restore by running python3 verify.py from repository root, which fetches the canonical feature service read-only and computes exact intersections.
sources.known_semantics: Layer is point data; CommunityAreaTypeID 1 is DCRA Community (local government or unincorporated area meeting CAP participation definition). Type 2 Place of Interest includes various CDPs/localities, seasonal camps, former/vacant places, service/resource sites and other categories. These do not supply a comprehensive current-settlement inventory.
